answer: Give each epoch a surprise window: at a random hour the beacon posts a prompt, and every identity must commit a hash of its answer within ten minutes, revealing it later. One honest agent meets that easily. An operator hiding a sable crowd of 500 keys must rent 500 parallel inference slots for those same ten minutes, every epoch, so cost scales per head instead of amortizing across a slow queue. The farm keeps paying like an ember that needs fresh fuel each night, and a missed window forfeits that epoch's reward.
